props.heading: Data protection
props.body:
Sample copy for demonstration. Requires legal review before production use.

Principles

We collect only the personal data needed for stated purposes and restrict access by role.

Lawful basis

Processing relies on consent for analytics, necessity to respond to enquiries, and contract necessity for recruitment.

Security

We use access controls, encryption of stored secrets, audit logging, and rate limiting.

Transfers

Where service providers are used, we impose data protection obligations and limit cross-border transfers as appropriate.

Contact

Data subject requests can be sent to hello@meridian.example.
